title: Cooperative Warp Execution in Tensor Core for RISC-V GPGPU
problem: Tensor cores integrated into RISC-V GPGPU architectures (e.g., Vortex) are severely under-utilized in many configurations, and simply increasing compute capacity does not yield proportional performance gains due to memory bandwidth limitations and warp divergence.
motivation: Open-source RISC-V GPGPU platforms lack efficient tensor core designs with principled analysis of the relationship between GPU system parameters and tensor core configuration, limiting research and customization beyond NVIDIA's closed ecosystem.
method: The researchers added a tensor core (specialized hardware for matrix multiplications) to the open-source Vortex RISC-V GPU and identified two bottlenecks slowing it down: memory bandwidth (how quickly data can move) and warp contention (multiple thread groups competing for the single tensor core). Their solution lets multiple warps share a single tensor core operation at the same time, which reduces the memory each warp must handle and allows the GPU to overlap data movement with computation. The hardware tensor core control system was enhanced to schedule and manage this sharing between warps.
key_novelty: Multiple warps can share a single tensor core operation simultaneously, reducing each warp's memory requirements and improving tensor core utilization by up to 3x compared to running separately.
contributions: First open-source tensor core integration into RISC-V Vortex GPGPU with GEMM intrinsics
Systematic analysis linking GPU architectural parameters to tensor core utilization
Cooperative warp execution mechanism enabling hardware-supported warp cooperation in tensor core
Up to 3x performance improvement over baseline tensor core implementation

metrics.speedup: up to 3x over baseline tensor core implementation

baselines: Vortex RISC-V GPGPU baseline tensor core without cooperative warp execution
limitations: Not discussed; evaluation is limited to Vortex simulation and may not capture all real silicon trade-offs.
primary_theme: cooperative warp tensor core for open-source RISC-V GPGPU
